title: SupportLtSharedAttempts
description: Server-only failure counts across all accounts at supportLtSettings/attempts. Keys of counts are v<verified code version>_<ten-minute bucket>, where the bucket is Math.floor(epochMillis / 600000). 200 failures for the current code and bucket block registration. Each failed check atomically increments its verified generation and bucket after commit, so delayed writes cannot block a newer code. Rotation replaces this document with an empty counts map and resetCodeVersion. Legacy bucket-only counts are included until the first reset marker, then ignored even if an older deployment writes them late.

resetCodeVersion.description: Code version at the last rotation or initial issuance. Its presence marks legacy unscoped failure counts as obsolete.
